[Section] Implementation of the System ::: Classification Algorithms ::: Support Vector Machine (SVM)
[source_id=33] SVM gives an optimal hyper-plane and it maximizes the margin between classes. We use Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel in our system to make decision boundary curve-shaped. For decision function shape, we use the original one-vs-one (ovo) decision function.
